focal_genealogical_receipt.1_app_object_domain_sheets_operation: The selected regional incidence imported from the APP-origin chain is retained. This delta begins after that selection and neither changes its sheets nor recomputes its seed census.
focal_genealogical_receipt.2_trit_state_regime_orientation: The same generated ternary regional data determine the inherited marked origin; the field construction varies no upstream ternary datum.
focal_genealogical_receipt.3_tpk_effective_composition: selectedOrigin -> inherited lattice and LatticeCarrier -> inherited chargedField and hmode -> normalField -> finite-support four-term expansion and proved mode symmetries -> normalField_commute -> descendantField permutation invariance -> stateField_create_intertwines and stateField_unique.
focal_genealogical_receipt.4_coefficient_origins: All derivative coefficients remain the previous divided binomial/falling-product coefficients. Rectangular support bounds follow from Laurent truncation on each actual vector and finite nonnegative-mode action. No frequency cut-off, target character or commutation axiom is supplied.
focal_genealogical_receipt.5_conserved_information: Same selected origin, marked lattice, cocycle, charge, oscillator multiplicities, carrier and vacuum. Permuting a word preserves its occupation and is proved to preserve its actual field; no new upstream selection, memory reset or state replacement occurs.
focal_genealogical_receipt.6_enriched_state_and_residence: The selected lattice is the already constructed exceptional publication of the shared regional origin. No second lattice is supplied as an independent state. Preservation here means reuse of that exact typed object, not a new theorem that the entire preceding history can be recovered from one field coefficient.
focal_genealogical_receipt.7_produced_output: Normal product commutation for every existing Laurent field; field independence of word order and equality by occupations; agreement of the state-field map with every oscillator word; complex linearity of normal products; creation recursion for every state; uniqueness under agreement with charged fields and that recursion.
focal_genealogical_receipt.8_posterior_recognition_and_falsifier: The written FLM continuation is preserved. No locality, Jacobi, twisted-sector or Monster theorem is assumed as a new axiom. Missing pointwise support bounds, an illegitimate exchange of sums, a mixed-sign commutation assumption or a false word-invariance identity would invalidate these Lean theorems; their actual dependencies are probed by the kernel.
